svg.title: LAFINA Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
svg.desc: Eight logical processes decompose LAFINA Process 0: accounts and preferences; personal planning; COR and calendar imports and exports; assistant and handbook answers; alarms and reminder calls; personal synchronization; speech and live voice; documents and recordings. Yellow external entities are the Student, DeepSeek, Pinecone and ElevenLabs. Open-ended D1 to D7 symbols are logical data stores. Repeated symbols are aliases, not separate users, services or databases. The system covers the Android and owner-confirmed Electron clients and shared backend; platform-specific labels describe the inspected Android implementation.

text.tspan: Level 1 · Decomposition of Process 0 · Android / Electron clients + shared backend
Logical flows verified against this checkout; desktop adapters are owner-confirmed, not inspected here.
Current UI uses local Whisper STT
Audio stays local in this UI path
Yellow rectangles = external entities. Numbered white boxes = processes. Open-ended D boxes = logical stores.
Arrows name data and show its direction. Repeated E / D / process IDs refer to the same entity, store or process.
D1–D5 and SQLite metadata in D6 share lafina.db on Android; D6 also includes device files. D7 is cloud PostgreSQL (Neon).
D2 sync scope: profile, task, event, time_block, reminder, note, custom_category. Device alarm clocks / files are outside that scope.
Online AI / voice require the applicable mode choice, connectivity and backend access. Local resources are needed for offline voice / search.
This is a logical feature DFD, not a call sequence or exhaustive table list. See lafina-data-flow.md for source evidence and limitations.
